name: Seduce Me 2: The Demon War
source:
Mika Anderson is suddenly thrown into the Abyssal Plains right before she is about to get married to one of the five Incubi Brothers featured in the first game. What’s even worse is that she is thrown there in the middle of a Rebellion against the Evil Demon Lord and must not only assist Diana and the Rebel Leaders in the war, but must watch as the man she loves fights alongside them after he comes to rescue her.

[Edited from [url=http://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=43&t=33174]Lemma Soft Forums[/url]]
translation:
米卡．安德森即將在五名夢魔兄弟之一的婚禮前，突然被捲入深淵平原。更糟糕的是，她被捲入了反抗邪惡魔王的叛亂，不僅必須協助戴安娜和叛軍領袖作戰，還要眼看著自己所愛的人前來營救她，並與他們並肩作戰。

［改編自[url=http://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=43&t=33174]LemmaSoft論壇[/url]］
